title: Kitna baaki hai, ek nazar mein
caption:
Grahak bole 'itna nahi bacha.' Aap ke paas poori list hoti hai kya? 👇
ScoreMyBiz, 30 din muft: link in bio.
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a shopkeeper who opens one customer's full history of sales and payments to settle a disagreement politely. ScoreMyBiz is free for 30 days on Google Play.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Imran: Imran is a calm kirana shop owner in his late thirties with a trimmed beard, a white kurta and a skull cap.
cast.Rashid: Rashid is a regular customer in his fifties with a salt-and-pepper moustache and a striped shirt.

scenes.vo: रशीद भाई महीने भर से उधार ले रहे थे।
scenes.sub: Rashid bhai mahine bhar se udhaar le rahe the.
scenes.art: Rashid at the counter of Imran's kirana shop picking up a bag of rice, Imran smiling, morning light.

scenes.vo: आज बोले, मेरा इतना बाकी नहीं है।
scenes.sub: Aaj bole, 'mera itna baaki nahi hai.'
scenes.art: Rashid shaking his head with raised eyebrows, Imran listening calmly with open hands.

scenes.vo: इमरान के पास बहस करने का मन नहीं था।
scenes.sub: Imran ke paas behas karne ka man nahi tha.
scenes.art: Imran taking a quiet breath, a customer waiting behind Rashid, shop shelves in the background.

scenes.vo: उसने कहा, रुकिए, पूरी सूची देखते हैं।
scenes.sub: Usne kaha, 'rukiye, poori soochi dekhte hain.'
scenes.art: Imran gesturing politely and picking up his phone, Rashid curious.

scenes.vo: हर बिक्री, हर भुगतान, तारीख़ के साथ।
scenes.sub: Har bikri, har bhugtaan, taareekh ke saath.

scenes.vo: रशीद ने ख़ुद एक-एक लाइन पढ़ी।
scenes.sub: Rashid ne khud ek-ek line padhi.
scenes.art: Rashid reading the phone screen held by Imran, glasses pushed up, thoughtful face.

scenes.vo: तीन हफ़्ते पहले का एक हिस्सा याद आ गया।
scenes.sub: Teen hafte pehle ka ek hissa yaad aa gaya.
scenes.art: Rashid tapping his forehead with a rueful smile, Imran laughing gently.

scenes.vo: बिना झगड़े के बात वहीं सुलझ गई।
scenes.sub: Bina jhagde ke baat wahin suljh gayi.
scenes.art: Rashid and Imran shaking hands over the counter, other customers smiling in the background.

scenes.vo: इमरान ने वही सूची रशीद को संदेश में भेज दी।
scenes.sub: Imran ne wahi soochi Rashid ko sandesh mein bhej di.
scenes.art: Imran tapping send on his phone while Rashid pockets his own phone, warm shop interior.

scenes.vo: आपके पास हर ग्राहक की पूरी सूची है?
scenes.sub: Aapke paas har grahak ki poori soochi hai?
scenes.art: Close-up of Imran smiling warmly at the viewer, shop shelves softly blurred behind.

scenes.vo: स्कोर माय बिज़। तीस दिन मुफ़्त।
